summary: Single checkbox (consents, boolean options) or a group of checkboxes for multiple choices with a shared label, description, and validation. Supports the indeterminate state for “select all”.
whenToUse: Independent multiple choices among a few visible options (up to ~7).
Explicit consents that require confirmation before submitting.
Hierarchical selection with an indeterminate state.
whenNotToUse: Settings that take effect immediately: use Switch.
A single choice among mutually exclusive options: use RadioGroup.
Many options or search: use MultiSelect.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form and used by CheckboxGroup.

props.name: description / errorMessage
props.description: Associated help text and error message.

props.name: CheckboxGroup: label, description, errorMessage, validate
props.description: Field anatomy and validation for the whole group.

props.name: CheckboxGroup: orientation
props.description: Layout of the options (horizontal options wrap).

inherits: Props of the react-aria-components CheckboxField/CheckboxGroup (name, form, onFocus, onBlur…).
accessibility: Visually hidden native checkbox input: native semantics and form submission.
The group is announced with its label; description and error are associated.
The indeterminate state uses a distinct icon (not color alone).
Clickable area extends to the label: target ≥ 24×24 px.
responsive: Long labels wrap aligned with the text, not under the checkbox.
In horizontal orientation, options wrap on narrow viewports.
customization: Size from density; colors from color.action.primary and color.border.strong.
commonMistakes: Using a checkbox for immediate actions (prefer Switch).
Omitting the visible label: provide at least aria-label.
Handling “select all” without isIndeterminate when the selection is partial.
